content:
BUILT CoLAB would like to invite you to attend the Demonstrator Workshops of the mobilising project REV@CONSTRUCTION in which it takes part.

These workshops, taking place on 24 and 25 May, in Porto and Lisbon, aim to present the activities, innovations and results obtained within each of the project's working groups, as well as showcase in detail the digital tools developed throughout REV@CONSTRUCTION, presented by the entities involved in the project!

Participation is free of charge, but registration is mandatory 👉 here.

Porto  📅 24 May
📍 ANJE – Associação Nacional de Jovens Empresários 
Workshops:
Digi4Construction – 9:30am – 12:30pm 
PAV 4.0 LC – 2:30pm – 4:30pm 

Lisbon  📅 25 May 
📍 Ordem dos Engenheiros – Região Sul

Workshops:
Digital Twin for the AEC sector – 9:30am – 12:30pm 
BIM4Bridges – 2:00pm – 4:00pm
